evidence.enrollment_strategy: First clean exemplar for automatic identity; centroid of3 explicitly verified exemplars for research comparison. Runtime supports2–8 human-verified examples; those counts are not independently validated.

limitations: Original EN2001 cross-day and far-field recall gates fail; retain those failures alongside fresh results.
Some fresh-person source sessions supplied other calibration people, although identities were disjoint.
Unknown-person trials are small and correlated; zero errors is not a population-level1% risk guarantee.
Acted strong-style oracle trials include wrong assignments; common colds remain untested.
This policy is not a biometric authentication or high-impact decision mechanism.
Short-query duration policy remains separately experimental.
